details: The U.S. Federal Reserve's recent hawkish stance, with some policymakers eyeing at least one more rate hike before year-end, has intensified pressure on cryptocurrency markets. Non-yielding assets like Bitcoin tend to underperform in high-rate environments as traditional yield-bearing instruments become more attractive. Bitcoin's losses deepened, falling below $60,000, and U.S.-listed Bitcoin exchange-traded funds (ETFs) experienced significant outflows, totaling over $4 billion in June.
title: Hawkish Fed Fuels Rate Hike Expectations, Bitcoin Dips Below $60K Amid ETF Outflows

details: The Bank of England's Monetary Policy Committee voted to hold the Bank Rate at 3.75% on June 18, 2026. Governor Andrew Bailey indicated a patient approach to interest rate adjustments, despite persistently elevated inflation and rising oil prices stemming from geopolitical tensions. While UK CPI inflation fell to 2.8% in May 2026, the Bank expects it to rise again, posing a challenge for the economy.
title: BoE Maintains Bank Rate at 3.75%, Signals Patience on Future Moves

details: The European Central Bank (ECB) is reportedly considering doubling the minimum reserve requirements for banks from 1% to 2% to reduce its interest bill and manage inflation-fighting side effects. Concurrently, the ECB formally endorsed the European Commission's plan to centralize supervision of major crypto firms, trading venues, and clearinghouses under the European Securities and Markets Authority (ESMA). This move, aiming for deeper EU capital market integration, would give ESMA direct supervisory authority over large cross-border crypto entities.
title: ECB Considers Doubling Bank Reserves; Backs Centralized Crypto Supervision

details: Taiwan's legislature has passed a new law that introduces comprehensive regulations for crypto platforms and stablecoin issuers. This new framework replaces the previous anti-money laundering system with a formal licensing regime and mandates full reserves for stablecoin issuers in domestic banks. This regulatory clarity is anticipated to foster increased institutional interest and positively impact the market prospects for Bitcoin and Ethereum.
title: Taiwan Introduces New Crypto & Stablecoin Regulations, Eyes Institutional Boost

details: The market for tokenized commodities is seeing the emergence of derivatives, with digital asset prime brokers executing the first tokenized gold derivatives trades. This development highlights the increasing integration of commodities into blockchain-based market infrastructure, offering 24/7 access, near real-time on-chain settlement, and efficient collateral use for traditional assets like gold and oil.
title: Derivatives in Tokenized Commodities Gain Traction with 24/7 Trading
